entries.03d2be7daede6a02: Its basic philosophy is 'Aiming for a sustainable, virtuous-cycle society through food', and it is advancing its long-term vision, the 'West Japan ¥500 billion Concept'. From the fiscal year ended February 2026, it is pursuing a 5-year medium-term management plan, the 'Setouchi 2814 Plan', which aims to achieve operating revenue of ¥280 billion with a 140-store structure by the fiscal year ended February 2030. For store openings, its main format is standardized 24-hour food supermarkets with sales floor areas of 600-tsubo and 450-tsubo, and it plans to proceed with concentrated openings in major cities within its trading area (dominant strategy).
entries.24ec635de36af008: Profit is what remains after deducting costs such as merchandise purchases, store operations and personnel expenses from revenue. Net income for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥8,987 million, up 0.8% from the previous year.
entries.3722a3ef310e1abb: A department that handles dairy products, general foods, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, sundries and other items. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥123,920 million, accounting for 56.5% of total sales.
entries.3d23086e911c36ea: A department that handles fruit and vegetables, fresh fish, prepared foods and meat. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥95,437 million, accounting for 43.5% of total sales.
entries.4067c9bff94c1440: A department that handles fruit and vegetables, fresh fish, prepared foods and meat.

entries.5e4d41b36cd5ade5: A retail chain operating 113 food supermarkets, mostly open 24 hours, in seven prefectures along the Seto Inland Sea coast, centered on Hiroshima and Okayama.
entries.6ceefa4c39d35bdb: A single-segment business that operates food supermarkets, mainly open 24 hours a day, with stores located in the seven Seto Inland Sea coastal prefectures of Hiroshima, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima, Hyogo and Yamaguchi.
entries.72c3cc8d0f5c72ca: Its customers are general consumers who use its stores along the Seto Inland Sea coast. As of February 28, 2026, it had 113 stores: 33 in Hiroshima Prefecture, 28 in Okayama Prefecture, 15 in Kagawa Prefecture, 15 in Hyogo Prefecture, 10 in Tokushima Prefecture, 9 in Ehime Prefecture and 3 in Yamaguchi Prefecture.
entries.79ea8cd0a3175603: The company is a standalone company with its registered head office in Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture and its headquarters in Hayashima, Tsukubo District, Okayama Prefecture, and it does not prepare consolidated financial statements. As of February 28, 2026, the number of employees was 1,437, and an average of 5,247 temporary employees supports store operations. As subsidiaries, it wholly owns Saijo Plaza, which manages and operates shopping centers, and Fujiya, which manufactures, processes and sells prepared foods and lunch boxes.
entries.88f7965be82c3604: In the food supermarket industry, a shrinking market due to population decline and intensifying competition are expected. Within this environment, the company has a community-focused store network concentrated in Hiroshima and Okayama prefectures, where its revenue is large: ¥67,361 million in Hiroshima Prefecture and ¥58,799 million in Okayama Prefecture.
entries.8937d6aed8bbeed3: A department that handles dairy products, general foods, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, sundries and other items.
entries.8b6196eb896b0c5f: Its distinguishing feature is that it combines 24-hour operations and a standardized store format, concentrates its stores in certain areas, and oversees integrated manufacturing, logistics and sales operations, including its distribution centers.
entries.9d557182a9517344: Its revenue mainly consists of payments for goods sold in its stores. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥225,719 million, up 7.1% from the previous year. The main factors were 6 new store openings and increased sales at stores opened in the previous year and at existing stores; sales at existing stores were 104.3% of the previous year's level.
entries.afdfb42e976188af: A retail business that sells food products such as fresh produce, fresh fish, prepared foods and meat to general consumers at stores along the Seto Inland Sea coast, and receives payment for the goods sold.
entries.b683d8e7cd250d0a: It operates food supermarkets that mainly open 24 hours. Its main format is opening standardized stores with sales floor areas of 600-tsubo and 450-tsubo as open-mall NSCs (Neighborhood Shopping Centers) combined with other business types. Products include fresh produce, fresh fish, prepared foods, meat, dairy, general foods, confectionery, alcoholic beverages and sundries, and it also operates the private brand 'Halows Selection'.
entries.b90261a7a9234cdf: The business environment in [Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address] is printed with the outlook of a shrinking market and intensifying competition, and the regional sales results in MD&A are printed with Hiroshima Prefecture ¥67,361 million and Okayama Prefecture ¥58,799 million (fiscal year ended February 2026).
entries.c496d2d67de32884: A single-segment business that operates food supermarkets, mainly open 24 hours a day, with stores located in the seven Seto Inland Sea coastal prefectures of Hiroshima, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima, Hyogo and Yamaguchi. As of February 28, 2026, the company had 113 stores and continues its dominant store opening strategy, concentrating stores in specific areas. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥225,719 million.
entries.d76a7da4497d7d52: The business model in [Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address] is printed with '24-hour total operation system', 'shopping centers centered on a standardized 600-tsubo sales floor supermarket' and 'integrated management of manufacturing, logistics and sales', and [Business Description] is printed with the continuation of dominant-area store openings.
